caption: The drawing features five distinct objects arranged vertically on a plain beige background. At the top center is a six-pointed star-shaped object, light purple in color with a subtle shimmer and intricate inner design. Below the star, in the middle, is a slender cylindrical tool with a pointed tip and a pale greenish hue, accentuated with gold-colored bands at intervals and a small ring on its upper section. Flanking this central tool are two symmetrical objects: on the left, a pair of ornate scissors with silver-gray metal blades and handles, including a touch of gold at the pivot point, and on the right, a sharp-pointed tool with a matching pale greenish handle and a similar gold accent, ending in a rounded end. At the bottom center, there is a small flask or bottle with a textured, lattice-like pattern, mostly in gray tones, and a short cylindrical neck, possibly a cap or stopper, colored in a pale gold or brass shade. The composition is symmetrical with the central axis formed by the star, cylindrical tool, and flask, and the scissors and pointed tool positioned equidistantly on either side.
title: Boudoir Set
